description: per-line service headways in minutes by time band. crowding scales with headway: a longer headway means fewer vehicles carrying the same demand. rail values come from the dotc gtfs release (2015, via github.com/sakayph/gtfs frequencies.txt); the edsa carousel band is provisional pending the dotr service-data research sweep; jeepneys dispatch continuously.

LRT-2.source: lrta line 2 train intervals doc: weekday peak 8-10 min, off-peak 9-12 min (midpoints)

MRT-3.source: dotr-mrt3 official letter 13 apr 2026: weekday peak 3.5 min (7-9am, 5-7pm), off-peak 5-5.5 min

EDSA-Bus.source: derived from the dotr edsa busway dispatch monitoring sheet: headway = 360 min / mean dispatches per 6h slot (6am/12pm/6pm slots ~175-194 dispatches, 12am slot ~17), march 2026 blocks

Jeepney.source: dotc gtfs 2015: jeepney routes dispatch near-continuously (1-2 min)
